why: Bertram Krüger is 'a member, no rank' on War Council and Grain Holders; Hinrik Maier is War Council rank 1, so he is not 'the strongest figure'.
Says blades are being forged by hammering; C3553 says the siege took the iron and the smiths have nothing to work with.
Carters waiting at the post to pass a toll under Siege: nothing comes in or goes out by road.
Offers nightly entertainment at multiple venues unmarked, though Inns and taverns are 'Stopped by the siege' (C3821) and fairs are stopped (C3826).
Pastries offered unmarked, 'available to those who can afford it', while the grain failed (famine, grain failed source) and Bakers' bread is marked scarce.
Calls the economy 'Diversified — broad base' while INCOME has Smuggling Network Revenue at 51% and C4329 says over half comes from a single source.
Says the people could not keep their ground against anyone who came for it; STATE gives defence Well-Defended (walls, garrison, watch, mages).
Says War Council carries out Noble Governorship's orders; QUARRELS/C3344 give a ruling that one power refuses to obey.
'Holds a third share in Grain Holders': PEOPLE gives Notburga Becker only 'a member, no rank' there; ranks 1-3 are Sabine Schneider, Ludwig Koch, Tobias Becker.
'The hall: Free of the criminals' while Noble Governorship members Isidor Jäger, Christiane Wagner, Karl Herrmann front for the Black market, Smuggling network and killer (C4643-C4649).
Presumes a dragon demanding tribute; no dragon in CRISIS, TENSIONS or PAST, and the crisis is an enemy army's siege.
Potter receives grain shipments by a covert route and sells them; siege: nothing comes in by road, imports cover None (C4353, C4820).
Claims the famine was caused by export decisions; FOOD gives the failed source as grain (harvest failed, C4358) and TRADE exports carry no food.
Says Hademar Pfeiffer, the governor of a Strong Noble Governorship, has only one asset left; page elsewhere has him holding the seat.
